text.en: Just me. Got a seat?
Hi, I'm here for a drink.
Nice to meet you. Didn't expect to find a bar here.
Hi.
Nice to meet you.
...Excuse me. Are you taking customers?
Ignoring people isn't very nice.
Are you going to take my order?

text.ko: ...내가 인내심이 좋은 편인데 더 이상은 못 참겠네.
text.en: ...I'm pretty patient, but I've had enough.
Hey, you. That's enough, don't you think?
How long do you think I'll wait?
{cocktail}. I'll have one of those.
Hmm, a {cocktail}, please.
Give me a {cocktail}.

text.ko: ... 너무 좋은데? 이런 건 처음 먹어봐.
text.en: ...This is really good. I've never tasted anything like it.
Fantastic. I'll have to come back tomorrow.

text.ko: 오... 괜찮은데? 실력이 꽤 좋나 보네.
text.en: Oh... not bad. You've got some real skill.
Hmm... it's drinkable... but a little disappointing.
This... doesn't seem right.

text.ko: 이건 내가 시킨 게 아니야. {cocktail} 시켰는데... 이걸 준다고?
text.en: This isn't what I ordered. I asked for a {cocktail}... and you give me this?
I'll have a {cocktail} this time, please.
Make me another {cocktail}.
I'll be back. Thanks for the drink, bartender.

text.ko: 뭐야, 이딴 곳에 진짜 술집이 있네.
text.en: What the hell? There's actually a bar in a dump like this.
Well, look at that. This place isn't half bad.
Hey, you've got a customer.

text.ko: 뭘 쳐다보는 거야? 주문 안 받아?
text.en: What are you staring at? You gonna take my order?
You'll regret keeping me waiting.

text.ko: 적당히 하고 주문 받지? 내가 인내심이 많지 않아요, 아가씨.
text.en: How about you quit messing around and take my order? I don't have much patience, miss.

text.ko: ...시발, 이럴 거면 문은 왜 열어 둔 거야?
text.en: ...Fuck. Why even leave the door open if this is how you run the place?

text.ko: 하, 아가씨. 나중에 좆되고 싶어서 그래?
text.en: Ha. You looking for trouble later, miss?

text.ko: 시발, 진짜 주문 안 받는다 이거지?
text.en: So you're really not taking my fucking order, huh?
Make me a {cocktail}. Let's see what you've got.
One {cocktail}.
{cocktail}.
Hey, miss. One {cocktail}!

text.ko: 이야! 이거 좆되는데? 여기로 오길 잘했네.
text.en: Damn! This is fucking amazing. Glad I came here.

text.ko: 시발. 이런 건 처음 마셔 보는데. 너 정말 괜찮은 놈이구나?
text.en: Fuck. Never had anything like this. You're pretty damn good, aren't you?

text.ko: 아, 존나 좋구만. 이 동네에서 이런 기분을 느낄 줄은 몰랐는데.
text.en: Ah, that's fucking good. Didn't think I'd ever feel this way in this neighborhood.

text.ko: 장난하나. 이런 쓰레길 줄 알았으면 그 돈 안 냈지.
text.en: You kidding me? If I'd known you were serving this crap, I wouldn't have paid.

text.ko: 시발, 좆같네. 뭔 병신 같은 걸 술이라고 준 거야?
text.en: Fuck, this is disgusting. What kind of bullshit are you passing off as booze?

text.ko: 야, 이 시발년아. 이딴 걸 돈 주고 팔아?
text.en: You fucking bitch. You actually charge money for this shit?

text.ko: 맛이 참 개오줌 같네. 장난하는 거야?
text.en: Tastes like dog piss. Are you screwing with me?

text.ko: 한 잔 더 마셔 봐야지. {cocktail} 한 잔 부탁해.
text.en: Think I'll have another. A {cocktail}, please.
Another {cocktail}.
Let me have a {cocktail}.
...So there's a bar in a place like this.
...Nice to meet you.
Excuse me. Are you going to take my order?

text.ko: 오자마자 무시받으려고 이딴 곳에 온 건 아닌데.
text.en: I didn't come to this dump just to be ignored the moment I walked in.

text.ko: 나 앉아 있는 건 알고 있는 거지?
text.en: You do know I'm sitting here, right?
Hey. Enough already. Take my order.

text.ko: 시발, 여기가 휴게소도 아니고 앉아만 있는 공간인가.
text.en: Fuck. What is this, a rest stop? Are we just supposed to sit here?
...What a shitshow of customer service.
Give me a {cocktail}.
{cocktail}.
A {cocktail}, please.

text.ko: ...뭐야 이거. 존나 맛있잖아? 이 정도일 줄은 몰랐는데.
text.en: ...What the hell? This is fucking delicious. Didn't expect it to be this good.
...That's good. You've got more skill than I gave you credit for.

text.ko: 괜찮네. 이유 없이 비싼 건 아니었나 보네.
text.en: Not bad. Guess that price tag wasn't just for show.

text.ko: ...맛이 좀 이상한데. 너 제대로 만든 거 맞아?
text.en: ...Tastes a little strange. You sure you made it right?

text.ko: ...개오줌 같은 맛이 나네. 너도 시바견이랑 똑같은 놈이냐?
text.en: ...Tastes like dog piss. Are you just like that Shiba Inu?

text.ko: 시발, 시간이랑 돈만 버렸네. 이딴 걸로 어떻게 장사를 하는 거지?
text.en: Fuck. What a waste of time and money. How do you stay in business serving this?

text.ko: 좆같은 맛이네. 이럴 거면 마약이나 넣어서 만들지 그래?
text.en: Tastes like shit. At this point, why not just put drugs in it?
Give me another {cocktail}.
I'll order another. A {cocktail}.
Another {cocktail}.
I'll order.
Hmm...
Are you taking orders?
You don't look that busy.
Guess this place isn't open for business.
...What are you doing?

text.ko: 적당히 하라고. 슬슬 짜증 날 것 같으니.
text.en: Enough already. I'm starting to get annoyed.
One {cocktail}.
I'll have a {cocktail}.
{cocktail}.
...You've got skill. Didn't expect a taste like this.
Not bad. Much better than the bars nearby.
...Thanks for the drink. You're not bad at this.

text.ko: ...돈 내고 이딴 걸 마시러 온 건 아닌데.
text.en: ...I didn't come here to pay for this crap.
Tastes like dog piss.

text.ko: 시발. 이딴 곳을 왜 온 건지 후회가 되는군.
text.en: Fuck. I'm regretting ever coming here.
Another {cocktail}, please.
A {cocktail} this time.
Another {cocktail}.
Hey, bartender!

text.ko: 한 잔 하러 왔는데 영업하는 거지?
text.en: I'm here for a drink. You're open, right?

text.ko: 뭐야, 여기 진짜 운영하는 곳이었잖아? 구라치는 줄 알았는데.
text.en: Wait, this place actually is open? Thought they were bullshitting me.

text.ko: 저기, 마스터? 손님 안 받을 거야?
text.en: Hello, bartender? Are you taking customers or not?

text.ko: ...저기, 내가 앞에 있는 거 보이기는 하는 거지?
text.en: ...Hey, you can see me standing right here, can't you?

text.ko: 내 말을 못 들은 거야, 아니면 무시하는 거야?
text.en: Did you not hear me, or are you ignoring me?

text.ko: 무시하는 거면 슬슬 적당히 하지? 나도 한 성깔하는데 말이야.
text.en: If you're ignoring me, you'd better cut it out. I've got a temper too, you know.

text.ko: 야! 나 무시하냐고. 시발, 왜 손님 응대를 안 하는 거야?
text.en: Hey! I asked if you're ignoring me. Why the fuck won't you serve your customers?

text.ko: 아니, 시발. 손님 안 받을 거야? 여기 영업하는 꼬라지가 개판이네.
text.en: Are you taking fucking customers or not? This place is a goddamn mess.
Hmm... then give me a {cocktail}!

text.ko: 예전에 마셨던 게 있었는데. {cocktail}? 그거 있으면 한 잔 줘.
text.en: There was something I had before. A {cocktail}? If you've got it, I'll have one.
{cocktail}! One {cocktail}, please.

text.ko: ...이야, 이거 죽이는데? 어떻게 만들었길래 이런 맛이 나는 거지?
text.en: ...Damn, this is killer! How'd you make it taste like this?

text.ko: 너 얼굴만큼 실력도 좋구나? 너무 맛있는데?
text.en: So your skills match that pretty face, huh? This is really good!

text.ko: ...역시 제대로 된 놈은 아니었나 보네. 쯧.
text.en: ...Guess you weren't any good after all. Tsk.

text.ko: 이거 잘못 만든 건 아니지? 그냥 이런 맛이 나는 게 맞는 거겠지?
text.en: You didn't make this wrong, did you? It's supposed to taste like this, right?

text.ko: ...이딴 건 애새끼들이 장난으로 만든 폭탄주 맛이랑 다를 게 없는데.
text.en: ...This tastes no different from some crap those little shits mix up as a joke.
I'll order a {cocktail} this time.

text.ko: {cocktail}? 이거 궁금한데. 이걸로 한 잔 더 주문할게요.
text.en: A {cocktail}? I'm curious about that one. I'll order one of those next, please.

text.ko: {cocktail}, 이거 괜찮다고 하던데, 이거 한 잔 더 줘요.
text.en: I heard the {cocktail} was good. I'll have one of those next, please.
Thanks for the drink. I'll come back sometime.

text.ko: 주문 받고 왜 가만히 있는 거야?
text.en: You took my order. Why are you just standing there?

text.ko: 레시피 까먹었어? 뭘 기다리고 있는 거야?
text.en: Forgot the recipe? What are you waiting for?

text.ko: 만들긴 한 거지? 술 안 줄 거야?
text.en: You did make it, right? Are you going to give me my drink?

text.ko: 야, 뭘 멀뚱멀뚱 있는 거야? 내가 주문한 거 안 줄 거야?
text.en: Hey, why are you just standing there staring? Where's the drink I ordered?
...It's just okay.
...Guess I'll go somewhere else.
Fuck... what a waste of time.
...Doesn't look like what I saw.

text.ko: 시발, 여긴 주문도 제대로 확인 안 해?
text.en: Fuck. Don't you even check the orders here?
Hic... one mooore drink...
Urp... s-sorry...
My stomach... doesn't feel good...
Thanks.
Oh? Looks better than I expected.
Finally. I've been waiting.
...Hmm.
Oh... thanks.

text.ko: ...기대한 내가 병신이지. 이쪽 술집이 다 그렇지 뭐.
text.en: ...I'm a fucking idiot for getting my hopes up. All the bars around here are the same.
Busy night? Take your time.
Well... perhaps not tonight.
As if I'd order anything else.
{cocktail}, by the book.
No rush. Just don't forget me.
Now I'm getting worried.
Much obliged.
...Better than Chris's. Our secret.
Good. By the book.
Passable.
...You need more practice.

text.ko: 이건 기사감이군. '신입 바텐더, 손님을 독살하려 들다'.
text.en: This is front-page material: 'Rookie bartender attempts poisoning.'
Hm? Is this what I ordered?
As I thought. I ordered a {cocktail}.
A fine drink. Give Chris my regards.
Let's call it an off night.
I'll come back another time.
I'm out of time. A pity.
This bar never changes.
Thanks for the drink. I'll be back.

text.ko: 얼빠진 새끼. 내가 다시 오나 봐라.
text.en: You brainless bastard. Like hell I'm ever coming back.

text.ko: 크리스는 안에 있나? ...아, 자네한테 시키면 되지.
text.en: Is Chris in? ...Ah, never mind. I can order from you.
Are you ready to order?
What can I get you?
Take your time looking, then let me know what you'd like.
Hmm... give me a moment.
Give me a moment. I've never been to a place like this.
Hmm... I've never been to a place like this.
Hmm... what should I drink...

text.ko: 너 이 동네 사람 아니지? 이 정도 미인이면 벌써 소문이 났을 텐데...
text.en: You're not from around here, are you? If someone this pretty lived here, word would've gotten around...

text.ko: 요즘 날씨가 참 지랄맞아서 밖에 돌아다닐 수가 없네.
text.en: The weather's been so fucking awful lately, I can't even go outside.

text.ko: 예전엔 손님이 많았다고 들었는데. 많이 변했나 보네.
text.en: Heard this place used to be packed. Guess a lot has changed.

text.ko: 전에 있던 마스터는 어디 가고 너 같은 미인이 있는 거지?
text.en: Where'd the old bartender go? And how did a beauty like you end up here?

text.ko: ...내 기대를 충족시켜 주면 좋을 것 같은데 말이지.
text.en: ...I'm hoping you'll live up to my expectations.

text.ko: ...너 좀 예쁘네. 이런 곳에서 미인은 흔치 않은데 말이지.
text.en: ...You're pretty. Don't see many beauties around here.

text.ko: 그나저나 되게 얼굴이 예쁜데. 얼굴만 보러 와도 될 정도야.
text.en: By the way, you've got a really pretty face. Worth coming here just to see it.

text.ko: 흠... 망할 갱 새끼들이 여긴 싸고돌던데 이유가 있는 건가?
text.en: Hmm... those damn gang bastards seem awfully protective of this place. Wonder why.
Hmm... let's see...
...I'm the fucking idiot for expecting anything in this neighborhood.
Ha... what a shitty day.
